title: Feed in the morning, bake after work

slides.headline: Stop feeding your starter at midnight
slides.visual: Starter jar next to a clock showing 12:00, crossed out
slides.alt: A jar of sourdough starter beside a clock at midnight, crossed out in red

slides.headline: Midnight feeds feel dedicated
slides.body: In practice, the starter peaks while you sleep and has sunk again by the time you are free to bake.

slides.headline: What I saw
slides.body: I used to feed mine at midnight. Half the time I was too tired to bake, so I moved the feed.

slides.headline: 1. Feed before work
slides.body: One feed at breakfast. It peaks by the time you get home.

slides.headline: 2. Mix at six
slides.body: Mix the dough as soon as you walk in, while the starter is at its peak.

slides.headline: 3. Let the fridge work
slides.body: Shape, then into the fridge overnight. Bake straight from cold the next evening.

slides.headline: Want the full weeknight schedule?
slides.body: Comment STARTER and I'll send you the checklist.
